scope: CPU serialization of one existing diagnostic activation archive; no inference or new corpus sampling
privacy: Only timings, byte counts and verification results are published. No corpus text, token IDs, activation values or private artifact paths are included.

method.source: One completed diagnostic activation NPZ, loaded once with allow_pickle=false
method.destination: In-memory BytesIO; one timed serialization per compression level
method.format: ZIP_DEFLATED NPZ containing standard NumPy NPY members; force_zip64=true; allow_pickle=false
method.roundtrip: Reload each archive with np.load(allow_pickle=false); require the same key set and exact dtype, shape and tobytes() for every source array

implementation_proof.required: Identical ZIP member names/order and identical uncompressed NPY member bytes, plus identical loaded names, dtypes, shapes and array bytes
coverage: FP32 signed zero and subnormal values

limits: This is a single-artifact CPU comparison, not an end-to-end GPU throughput result or a distribution across the corpus. Compressed archive hashes change; exact decoded arrays and all runtime/provenance validators remain required. The changed probe source creates a new runtime identity and requires an explicit audited transition.
